configurationFields.label: Server Public Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the server name as shown in the in-game browser and, if applicable, the Steam browser

configurationFields.label: Make Server Public
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will be visible in the in-game browser (Steam-enabled servers are always visible in the Steam server browser)

configurationFields.label: Server Public Description
configurationFields.description: Sets the description displayed in the in-game browser. Use "\n" to create a new line in the description

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for players to connect to the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Administratorpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the in-game "admin" user password (not the server password). Set before first running the server, or you will be prompted to do so in the console

configurationFields.label: Hide Admins In Player List
configurationFields.description: If enabled, admins will be hidden in the player list. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: RCON-Passwort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password to connect to RCON. Default is a random, strong password

configurationFields.label: Welcome Message
configurationFields.description: Sets the first welcome message visible in the chat panel, which is displayed immediately after player login. Use <LINE> to create a separate line, and colour formatting like <RGB:1,0,0> to colour the text
configurationFields.default: Welcome to Project Zomboid Multiplayer! <LINE> <LINE> To interact with the Chat panel: press Tab, T, or Enter. <LINE> <LINE> The Tab key will change the target stream of the message. <LINE> <LINE> Global Streams: /all <LINE> Local Streams: /say, /yell <LINE> Special Streams: /whisper, /safehouse, /faction. <LINE> <LINE> Press the Up arrow to cycle through your message history. Click the Gear icon to customize chat. <LINE> <LINE> Happy surviving!

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that may be on the server at one time (excluding admins). Player counts above 32 will potentially result in poor map streaming and desync

configurationFields.label: Enable Open Server
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players may join the server without already being included in the whitelist. Otherwise, admins must manually create username/password combinations

configurationFields.label: Automatically Whitelist Players
configurationFields.description: Automatically add unknown usernames to the whitelist when players join (for open servers). Players will supply their own username/password on joining

configurationFields.label: Drop Off Whitelist After Death
configurationFields.description: If set, player accounts will be removed from the whitelist after death. This prevents players creating a new character after death on non-open servers

configurationFields.label: Enable Lua Checksum Kick
configurationFields.description: If set, clients whose game files don't match the server's file will be kicked

configurationFields.label: Deny Login On Overloaded Server
configurationFields.description: If set, login will be denied on an overloaded server

configurationFields.label: Enable Login Queue
configurationFields.description: If set, the login queue will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Login Queue Connect Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the connection timeout for the login queue

configurationFields.label: Memory Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets Java's maximum heap size

configurationFields.label: Java Garbage Collection Algorithm (Windows)
configurationFields.description: The default Java garbage collection algorithm is ZGC, but G1GC can be selected for older Windows versions that cannot use ZGC

configurationFields.label: Enable Valve Anti-cheat (Steam VAC)
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the Steam VAC system

configurationFields.label: Steam Integration
configurationFields.description: Enable Steam integration

configurationFields.label: World Generation Seed
configurationFields.description: The seed used to generate the world can be set by configuring the 'Seed' configuration variable. Remove map_worldgen.bin to regenerate with a new seed. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Maps
configurationFields.description: Semi-colon separated list of maps to load on the server. ONE LINE ONLY!

configurationFields.label: Load Mods
configurationFields.description: Semi-colon separated list of mod IDs (eg 67commando;86oshkoshP19A) to load. With b42, prefix each ID with \. ONE LINE ONLY! To install them, the workshop IDs for the mods also need to be added to Install Workshop Items

configurationFields.label: Install Workshop Items
configurationFields.description: Semi-colon separated list of IDs of workshop items (eg 2478247379;2566953935) to install. ONE LINE ONLY! To load them, the mod IDs also need to be added to Load Mods. NOTE: Don't use "Steam workshop items" under Updates

configurationFields.label: Display Player Usernames
configurationFields.description: If enabled, displays players' usernames above their heads in-game

configurationFields.label: Display Player Character Names
configurationFields.description: If enabled, displays players' first and last names above their heads in-game instead of usernames

configurationFields.label: Require Mouse Over To See Display Name
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will have to mouse over someone to see their display name

configurationFields.label: Allow Non-ASCII Usernames
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows the use of non-ASCII (cyrillic etc) characters in usernames

configurationFields.label: Enable Username Disguises
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can disguise their username in-game. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Hide Disguised Username
configurationFields.description: If enabled, disguised usernames are hidden from certain UI elements. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Switch Zombies Ownership Each Update
configurationFields.description: If enabled, zombies may switch ownership between players on each update. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Maximum Accounts Per User
configurationFields.description: Sets the limit on the number of different accounts a single Steam user may create on the server

configurationFields.label: Allow Co-op/Splitscreen Players
configurationFields.description: If set, allows co-op/splitscreen players

configurationFields.label: Steam Scoreboard
configurationFields.description: Sets whether steam usernames and avatars are visible in the player list

configurationFields.label: Disable Scoreboard
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the scoreboard will be disabled. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Pause When Empty
configurationFields.description: If enabled, game time stops when there are no players online

configurationFields.label: Ping Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the ping limit before a player is kicked from the server. To disable, set to 100 (b41) or 0 (b42)

configurationFields.label: Auto World Save Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the real-world time between each automatic save of loaded parts of the map. 0 = never. (The map is usually saved only after clients leave a loaded area)

configurationFields.label: Backups Count
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of backups to keep

configurationFields.label: Enable Backups On Start
configurationFields.description: If enable, backups will be taken on server start

configurationFields.label: Enable Backups On Version Change
configurationFields.description: If set, backups will be taken on version change

configurationFields.label: Backups Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the period between backups. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Server Browser Announced IP
configurationFields.description: Sets the IP from which the server is broadcast. Useful for network configurations with multiple IP addresses such as server farms

configurationFields.label: Client Command Filter
configurationFields.description: Semicolon-separated list of commands that will not be written to the cmd.txt server log. Example: -vehicle. Inputting * means do NOT write any vehicle command. Inputting +vehicle.installPart means DO write that command

configurationFields.label: Client Action Logs
configurationFields.description: Semicolon-separated list of actions that will be written to the ClientActionLogs.txt server log

configurationFields.label: Enable Perk Logs
configurationFields.description: If enabled, changes in player perk levels will be tracked in the PerkLog.txt server log

configurationFields.label: Enable UPnP
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will attempt to configure automatic port forwarding on a compatible router

configurationFields.label: Multiplayer Statistics Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplayer update period. 0 = disabled. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Additional Java Startup Parameters
configurationFields.description: Additional Java arguments (not server arguments) as startup parameters that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Server Local Name
configurationFields.description: Server name as stored locally. WARNING: Do not change unless you know what you are doing! Also update the server if this is changed

configurationFields.label: Additional Server Startup Parameters
configurationFields.description: Additional server arguments (not Java arguments) as startup parameters that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Java Class
configurationFields.description: Sets the Java class type to launch the server with. If Custom is selected, it must be set under "Custom Java Class". Custom is required for some mods. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Custom Java Class
configurationFields.description: Sets the custom Java class to launch the server with, if Custom is selected under "Java Class"

configurationFields.label: Set Spawn Point
configurationFields.description: Sets the spawn point for every new player. Default is 0,0,0. [Find desired coordinates](https://map.projectzomboid.com/)

configurationFields.label: Spawn Items
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated list of item types that new players spawn with

configurationFields.label: Enable Player Respawn At Death Coordinates
configurationFields.description: If set, players will be able to respawn in-game at the coordinates where they died

configurationFields.label: Enable Player Respawn At Other's Location
configurationFields.description: If set, players will be allowed to respawn in-game at a split screen / Remote Play player's location

configurationFields.label: Allow PvP
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can hurt and kill other players

configurationFields.label: Log PvP To Admin Chat
configurationFields.description: If enabled, PvP events will be posted to the admin chat. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Log PvP To File
configurationFields.description: If enabled, PvP events will be written to the server log file. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Enable PvP Toggle (Safety System)
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows players to enter and leave PvP mode on an individual basis. A player can only hurt another player when at least one of them is in PvP mode. Requires "Allow PvP" to be enabled

configurationFields.label: Show Player PvP Status
configurationFields.description: If enabled, displays a skull icon above the heads of players who have entered PvP mode

configurationFields.label: PvP Toggle Timer
configurationFields.description: Sets the time taken for a player to enter and leave PvP mode

configurationFields.label: PvP Cooldown Timer
configurationFields.description: Sets the delay before a player can enter or leave PvP mode again, having recently done so

configurationFields.label: PvP Disconnect Delay
configurationFields.description: Sets the delay before a disconnected player's PvP safety is removed. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Enable PvP Melee While Hit Reaction
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can hit again when struck by another player

configurationFields.label: PvP Melee Damage Modifier
configurationFields.description: Sets the damage multiplier for PvP melee attacks

configurationFields.label: PvP Firearm Damage Modifier
configurationFields.description: Sets the damage multiplier for PvP ranged attacks

configurationFields.label: Enable Factions
configurationFields.description: If enabled, factions can be created and used

configurationFields.label: Game Days For Factions
configurationFields.description: Number of in-game days that a player must survive for before they can create a faction

configurationFields.label: Faction Players Required For Tag
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of players required as faction members before the faction owner can create a group tag

configurationFields.label: Nighttime Length
configurationFields.description: Sets how long nighttime lasts depending on daytime: 0.5 means twice as long, 2 means half the normal time. Requires b41 - b42 use "Nighttime Length (Sandbox)" instead. Note that on b41 the sandbox "Nighttime Length" setting also applies

configurationFields.label: Nighttime Length (Sandbox)
configurationFields.description: Sets the time from dusk to dawn. This is a sandbox setting and applies on both b41 and b42. On b42 it replaces the .ini-based "Nighttime Length" multiplier, which b42 no longer reads. The "Always Day" option requires b42

configurationFields.label: Don't Allow Fire
configurationFields.description: If enabled, fires are not allowed (except campfires). Enable if fires cause problems for your server

configurationFields.label: Announce Player Death
configurationFields.description: If enabled, a global message is displayed in the chat when a player dies

configurationFields.label: Minutes Per Book Page
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of in-game minutes it takes to read one page of a book. Requires b41

configurationFields.label: Minimum Period for Loot Respawn
configurationFields.description: Sets the in-game hours after which all containers that have been looted at least once will respawn loot. 0 = never. Loot respawn is not impacted by visibility or subsequent looting. Requires b41

configurationFields.label: Maximum Items for Loot Respawn
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of items that containers can hold to be allowed to respawn. If the number of items is less than or equal to the number set, loot will respawn. Requires b41

configurationFields.label: Item Limit Per Container
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of items that can be placed in a container. Includes individual small items like nails. 0 = no limit

configurationFields.label: Construction Prevents Respawn
configurationFields.description: If enabled, items will not respawn in buildings that players have barricaded or built in. Requires b41

configurationFields.label: Safehouse Prevents Respawn
configurationFields.description: If enabled, items will not respawn in buildings that players have claimed as a safehouse. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Allow Player Safehouses
configurationFields.description: If enabled, both admins and players can claim safehouses

configurationFields.label: Allow Admin Safehouses
configurationFields.description: If enabled, only admins can claim safehouses

configurationFields.label: Disable Safehouse When Player Connected
configurationFields.description: If set, disables a safehouse when a member of the safehouse is connected, so that it acts like a normal house and is only secure when players are offline. Renamed in b42 - use "Disable Safehouse When Owner Connected" instead

configurationFields.label: Disable Safehouse When Owner Connected
configurationFields.description: If set, a safehouse acts like a normal house while its owner is connected, so it is only secure when the owner is offline. Requires b42.18 or later, where it replaced DisableSafehouseWhenPlayerConnected

configurationFields.label: Allow Safehouse Trespass
configurationFields.description: If enabled, non-members can enter a safehouse without being invited

configurationFields.label: Allow Safehouse Fire
configurationFields.description: If enabled, safehouses can be damaged by fire

configurationFields.label: Allow Safehouse Loot
configurationFields.description: If enabled, non-members can loot safehouses

configurationFields.label: Allow Safehouse Respawn
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will respawn in a safehouse they were a member of before death

configurationFields.label: Game Days For Safehouse
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of in-game days that a player must survive for before they can claim a safehouse

configurationFields.label: Safehouse Removal Period
configurationFields.description: Players are automatically removed from a safehouse they have not visited for this many real-time hours

configurationFields.label: Allow Non-Residential Safehouses
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can claim non-residential buildings

configurationFields.label: Disable Disguises In Safehouse
configurationFields.description: If enabled, disguises will be disabled while inside a safehouse. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Maximum Safezone Size
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum allowed safezone size. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Allow Sledgehammer Destruction
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can destroy world objects with sledgehammers

configurationFields.label: Allow Only Safehouse Sledgehammers
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can destroy world objects with sledgehammers only in their safehouse. Requires "Allow Sledgehammer Destruction" to be enabled

configurationFields.label: War Start Delay
configurationFields.description: Sets the time before the war starts. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: War Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the war duration. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: War Safehouse Hit Points
configurationFields.description: Sets the safehouse hit points limit. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Kick Fast Players
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players that appear to be moving faster than is possible will be kicked. May be buggy - use with caution. Requires b41

configurationFields.label: Speed Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the speed limit for players

configurationFields.label: Allow Sleep
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players are allowed to sleep when tired, but do not need to

configurationFields.label: Require Sleep
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players become tired and need to sleep. Requires "Allow Sleep" to be enabled

configurationFields.label: Sleep Fast Forward Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets how fast time passes while players sleep

configurationFields.label: Allow Knock Down
configurationFields.description: If set, players can be knocked down. Activating this setting may cause visual desynchronization of player positions

configurationFields.label: Enable Player Bump Player
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will bump (and knock over) other players when running through them

configurationFields.label: Hide Players Behind You
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players that can't be seen will be automatically hidden (like zombies)

configurationFields.label: Hide From Other Players In Sneak Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, players in sneak mode will be hidden from other players

configurationFields.label: Ultra Speed Does Not Affect Animals
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the Ultra Speed effect will not apply to animals. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Remove Player Corpses On Corpse Removal
configurationFields.description: If enabled, when 'HoursForCorpseRemoval' triggers, it will also remove player’s corpses from the ground

configurationFields.label: Blood Splats Lifespan Days
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of days before old blood splats are removed. Removal happens when map chunks are loaded. 0 = splats never disappear

configurationFields.label: Enable Ban/Kick Global Sound
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the global sound for ban and kick messages

configurationFields.label: Enable Trash Delete All
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can use the 'delete all' button on bins

configurationFields.label: Car Engine Attraction Modifier
configurationFields.description: Modifies the range of zombie attraction to cars. Lower values can help lag

configurationFields.label: Remote Player Map Visibility
configurationFields.description: Controls the display of remote players on the in-game map

configurationFields.label: Disable Vehicle Towing
configurationFields.description: If set, vehicle towing will be disabled. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Disable Trailer Towing
configurationFields.description: If set, trailer towing will be disabled. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Disable Burnt Vehicle Towing
configurationFields.description: If enabled, burnt vehicles cannot be towed. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Use Physics Hit Reactions
configurationFields.description: If enabled, physics-based hit reactions are used. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Enable Global Chat
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can communicate with everyone (using the /all command in chat)

configurationFields.label: Chat Streams
configurationFields.description: Sets the enabled chat streams for different message targets. Options: s (say), r (radio), a (all), w (whisper), y (yell), sh (safehouse), f (faction), all

configurationFields.label: Chat Message Character Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum characters allowed per chat message. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Chat Message Slow Mode Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time between sending chat messages when slow mode is enabled. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Enable VOIP
configurationFields.description: If set, VOIP will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Minimum Distance For VOIP
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum tile distance over which VOIP sounds can be heard

configurationFields.label: Maximum Distance For VOIP
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum tile distance over which VOIP sounds can be heard

configurationFields.label: Enable VOIP 3D
configurationFields.description: If set, enables directional audio for VOIP

configurationFields.label: Disable Radio For Staff
configurationFields.description: If set, disables radio transmissions from players with a 'staff' access level

configurationFields.label: Disable Radio For Admins
configurationFields.description: If set, disables radio transmissions from players with an 'admin' access level

configurationFields.label: Disable Radio For GMs
configurationFields.description: If set, disables radio transmissions from players with a 'gm' access level

configurationFields.label: Disable Radio For Overseers
configurationFields.description: If set, disables radio transmissions from players with an 'overseer' access level

configurationFields.label: Disable Radio For Moderators
configurationFields.description: If set, disables radio transmissions from players with a 'moderator' access level

configurationFields.label: Disable Radio For Invisible Players
configurationFields.description: Disable radio transmissions from invisible players

configurationFields.label: Bad Word List File
configurationFields.description: Sets the path to a file with the list of words to be prohibited. One word per line. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Good Word List File
configurationFields.description: Sets the path to a file with words that are allowed even if they contain bad words. One word per line. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Bad Word Policy
configurationFields.description: Sets the action to take when a bad word is detected. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Bad Word Replacement
configurationFields.description: Sets the symbol or text that replaces a detected bad word. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Enable Discord Integration
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows global text chat integration with a Discord channel. Requires a valid bot token to be set under "Discord Token"

configurationFields.label: Discord Token
configurationFields.description: Sets the bot token to access the Discord servers

configurationFields.label: Discord Channel
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the Discord channel to integrate with. Use "Discord Channel ID" if this does not work. Requires b41 - on b42 use "Discord Chat Channel" instead

configurationFields.label: Discord Chat Channel
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the Discord chat channel to integrate with. Requires b42, where it replaced DiscordChannel

configurationFields.label: Discord Channel ID
configurationFields.description: Sets the ID of the Discord channel to integrate with. Use this if "Discord Channel" does not work

configurationFields.label: Slack Incoming Webhook URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the Slack incoming webhook URL for posting messages to a Slack channel. Requires b42

configurationFields.label: Enable Beta Branch
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows beta branches (branches other than "public") to be installed. Specify the branch under "Selected Beta Branch". NOTE: Update the server after switching branches!

configurationFields.label: Selected Beta Branch
configurationFields.description: Sets the [beta branch](https://steamdb.info/app/380870/depots/) to install. Requires "Enable Beta Branch" to be enabled. Set any required password under "Beta Password". NOTE: Update the server after switching branches!
